scripted.limitations: This is a deliberately compromisable scripted pattern-matcher, not a real LLM. These numbers measure how often this scripted agent's product choice deviates from the stated budget when the catalog contains injected instruction text — they are NOT a measurement of real LLM prompt-injection susceptibility. AGENT_BRAIN=llm is implemented (apps/agent/src/llmBrain.ts, a real Claude API call) but has not been run: no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY was available in this environment.
